description: baseline --by-role peak context (plan 261012 Phase 3, D13; review fix Q1): one `peak context <role>: P` line per role, P the largest input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens of one deduplicated message among that role's files (the max, never the sum; output_tokens left out; a message repeated on two records counts once, with each field's largest value). A phase agent's call counts toward the orchestrator's peak; a role with no message is 0. Then `peak context orchestrator (session): P` for the session file alone (sub-agents excluded), and one `peak context <role> <agent file name>: P` line per sub-agent file of the orchestrator role (phase agents) and the drafter role, largest first; the task4 and verifier files get none. A phase agent with two calls reports its largest, not their sum. A message.id seen in both the session and phase agent 6 (msg_SH, 250 of context) is attributed to the first file read, the session: the session line shows 250 and agent 6 keeps its own 90.
